summary: Load-bearing tests (testSubmittedPromptReportsNoPromptContent, testDiagnosticEventsRejectSensitiveRawErrorText) exercise real production code with hostile content covering all 9 forbidden categories via the only two real injection vectors (prompt flow; raw-error classification); minor non-blocking gaps: one test mistagged (asserts failureKind taxonomy, not properties), attachment leak only indirectly covered, model/provider token generic.
